description: Focus on making consistent contact with proper swing mechanics
detailed_instructions: Set up tee at various heights (thigh, belt, chest). Take 25 swings at each height focusing on: 1) Balanced setup 2) Short stride 3) Hands to ball 4) Extension through contact 5) Follow through to target
Partner sits to side and tosses balls underhand. Focus on: 1) Tracking ball from release 2) Quick hands to contact 3) Square contact 4) Line drive swing plane 5) Hitting ball where it's pitched

description: Work on timing and pitch recognition
detailed_instructions: Coach/partner tosses from 15-20 feet in front. Mix speeds and locations. Focus on: 1) Loading properly 2) Recognizing spin early 3) Adjusting timing 4) Staying balanced through swing

description: Learn to identify fastball vs off-speed
detailed_instructions: Use video or live BP to practice identifying pitch types. Coach calls out pitch type after release. Track: 1) Initial read 2) Spin recognition 3) Speed differential 4) Location awareness
Take BP with specific counts and situations: 0-2, 2-0, runner on 2nd, etc. Focus on: 1) Approach adjustment 2) Contact vs power 3) Situational hitting 4) Pressure execution

description: Increase bat speed and exit velocity
detailed_instructions: Use weighted bats and overload/underload training. Track exit velocities. Focus on: 1) Hip rotation 2) Torque creation 3) Bat speed through zone 4) Optimal launch angle
equipment_needed: Weighted Bats | Radar Gun | Tee | Baseballs

detailed_instructions: Use high-speed video and pitch tunneling drills. Practice: 1) Spin rate identification 2) Release point consistency 3) Pitch tunneling recognition 4) Sequential pattern reading
Practice shortening swing and making contact with two strikes. Focus on: 1) Shortened swing 2) Contact over power 3) Opposite field approach 4) Fouling off tough pitches

description: Handle high velocity while maintaining timing
detailed_instructions: Use pitching machines at various speeds (85-95+). Practice: 1) Quick trigger 2) Shortened load 3) Timing adjustments 4) Maintaining mechanics at speed

description: Master count leveraging and advanced approach
detailed_instructions: Practice working counts and hunting specific pitches. Focus on: 1) Count awareness 2) Pitch hunting 3) Taking borderline pitches 4) Executing game plan

description: Maximize exit velocity and launch angle
detailed_instructions: Use biomechanical analysis and launch angle training. Focus on: 1) Optimal attack angle 2) Maximum exit velocity 3) Launch angle consistency 4) Power to all fields
equipment_needed: Launch Angle Trainer | Radar Gun | Biomechanics Equipment

detailed_instructions: Throw to specific zones using target practice. Focus on: 1) Hitting strike zone corners 2) Consistent release point 3) Proper mechanics 4) Building command confidence
Practice delivery with emphasis on balance. Focus on: 1) Leg lift balance 2) Stride direction 3) Hip/shoulder separation 4) Consistent finish

description: Develop basic changeup feel and command
detailed_instructions: Learn proper changeup grip and arm action. Focus on: 1) Circle change grip 2) Same arm speed as fastball 3) Commanding strike zone 4) Feel for pitch
Throw structured bullpen with game-like approach. Focus on: 1) Fastball command 2) Secondary pitch usage 3) Pitch sequencing 4) Attacking hitters
Focus on commanding secondary pitches for strikes. Focus on: 1) Consistent break/fade 2) Strike zone command 3) Feel and release 4) Arm action consistency

description: Practice pitching with runners on base
detailed_instructions: Simulate game situations with base runners. Focus on: 1) Slide step timing 2) Pickoff moves 3) Pitch selection 4) Pressure execution

description: Master setting up hitters and changing eye levels
detailed_instructions: Practice sophisticated pitch sequencing patterns. Focus on: 1) Setting up sequences 2) Eye level changes 3) Speed changes 4) Location patterns
Practice hitting exact locations under pressure. Focus on: 1) Corner command 2) Pressure execution 3) Fine location control 4) Consistent mechanics

description: Increase fastball velocity while maintaining command
detailed_instructions: Use weighted ball and long toss programs. Focus on: 1) Hip/shoulder separation 2) Arm strength 3) Leg drive 4) Maintaining command
equipment_needed: Weighted Balls | Long Toss Program | Radar Gun

detailed_instructions: Complete dynamic movement sequence: 1) Leg swings 2) Hip circles 3) Arm circles 4) Torso rotations 5) Light swings 6) Activation exercises
Complete J-Band routine: 1) External rotation 2) Internal rotation 3) Scapular stabilization 4) Posterior capsule stretch 5) Sleeper stretch
Structured long toss program: 1) 60 feet (10 throws) 2) 90 feet (10 throws) 3) 120 feet (10 throws) 4) 150 feet (5 throws) 5) Return progression
Complete vision sequence: 1) Tracking drills 2) Depth perception 3) Peripheral awareness 4) Focus shifting 5) Ball tracking exercises
Complete recovery sequence: 1) Cool down jog 2) Static stretching 3) Foam rolling 4) Hydration 5) Nutrition timing
Practice mental skills: 1) Visualization 2) Breathing techniques 3) Positive self-talk 4) Focus routines 5) Pressure management
